FORBIDDEN_WORDS._description: Seed data for system.forbidden_words table. First-line synchronous filter (Contains check). HerBERT handles context/intent as async second layer.
FORBIDDEN_WORDS._warning: Each word is matched via string.Contains() - use minimal roots that ONLY appear in profane words. Avoid roots matching innocent words (e.g. 'ass' in 'classic', 'dup' in 'duplikat', 'ruch' in 'ruchliwy', 'suk' in 'sukces', 'ciot' in 'ciotka').
FORBIDDEN_WORDS._reserved_note: Used ONLY for username validation (Register + UpdateProfile), NOT for review content. Contains() check on username - avoid short roots that appear in normal names (e.g. 'mod' in 'modelka', 'bot' in 'robotyk', 'info' in 'informatyk').
FORBIDDEN_WORDS._spam_note: Regex patterns for catching spam links in review content. Category: Profanity, IsRegex: true. Not matched against usernames (those use Reserved|Offensive).
